   1 class_name AnimationSystem extends System
   2 
   3 @export var runtime: Node = null
   4 
   5 func setup() -> void:
   6 	assert(is_instance_valid(runtime))
   7 
   8 func query() -> QueryBuilder:
   9 	return q.with_all([C_Visual]).enabled()
  10 
  11 func process(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, _delta: float) -> void:
  12 	for entity in entities:
  13 		if not entity.enabled:
  14 			continue
  15 		var visual: C_Visual = entity.get_component(C_Visual)
  16 		if not is_instance_valid(visual.node):
  17 			continue
  18 		var motion: C_Motion = entity.get_component(C_Motion)
  19 		var combat: C_Combat = entity.get_component(C_Combat)
  20 		var health: C_Health = entity.get_component(C_Health)
  21 		var boss: C_Boss = entity.get_component(C_Boss)
  22 		var ai: C_EnemyAI = entity.get_component(C_EnemyAI)
  23 		var heroine: bool = visual.asset_id == "heroine_frames"
  24 		if motion != null:
  25 			visual.facing = motion.facing
  26 			visual.animation = "run" if absf(motion.velocity.x) > 8.0 else "idle"
  27 			if heroine and not motion.grounded:
  28 				visual.animation = "jump"
  29 			elif not heroine and visual.animation == "run":
  30 				visual.animation = "move"
  31 		if combat != null:
  32 			if combat.state.begins_with("sword"):
  33 				visual.animation = "attack" if heroine else "melee_attack"
  34 			elif combat.state.begins_with("cast"):
  35 				visual.animation = "cast"
  36 			elif combat.state == "dodge" and heroine:
  37 				visual.animation = "dodge"
  38 		if boss != null:
  39 			visual.animation = "attack" if combat.state.begins_with("boss_") else "idle"
  40 		if health != null and health.hurt_left > 0.0 and boss == null:
  41 			visual.animation = "hurt" if heroine else "idle"
  42 		if visual.node is AnimatedSprite2D:
  43 			var sprite: AnimatedSprite2D = visual.node
  44 			sprite.flip_h = visual.facing > 0 if boss != null else visual.facing < 0
  45 			if heroine:
  46 				visual.offset.y = -102.0 if visual.animation == "cast" else (-106.0 if visual.animation == "hurt" else -105.0)
  47 			elif visual.asset_id == "dealer_frames":
  48 				visual.offset.y = -88.0 if visual.animation == "melee_attack" else (-56.0 if visual.animation == "cast" else -54.0)
  49 			elif boss != null:
  50 				visual.offset.y = -186.0 if visual.animation == "attack" else -136.0
  51 			sprite.offset = visual.offset
  52 			if runtime.session.mode != "playing":
  53 				sprite.pause()
  54 			elif sprite.animation != visual.animation or (not sprite.is_playing() and (sprite.sprite_frames.get_animation_loop(visual.animation) or sprite.frame < sprite.sprite_frames.get_frame_count(visual.animation) - 1)):
  55 				if not sprite.sprite_frames.has_animation(visual.animation):
  56 					runtime.fail("Missing animation: " + visual.asset_id + "/" + visual.animation)
  57 					continue
  58 				sprite.play(visual.animation)
  59 		elif visual.node is Sprite2D and ai != null and ai.kind == "flying":
  60 			visual.node.flip_h = visual.facing < 0
  61 			visual.node.rotation = clampf(motion.velocity.x / 900.0, -0.4, 0.4)
  62 		if boss != null:
  63 			var root: Node = visual.node.get_parent()
  64 			var bar: ProgressBar = root.get_node_or_null("BossHealth")
  65 			var title: Label = root.get_node_or_null("BossTitle")
  66 			if bar != null:
  67 				bar.max_value = health.maximum
  68 				bar.value = health.current
  69 			if title != null:
  70 				title.text = "皇家庄家 · 第%d阶段   %d / %d" % [boss.phase, health.current, health.maximum]
  71 		var tint: Color = visual.tint
  72 		if health != null and health.hurt_left > 0.0:
  73 			tint = tint.lerp(Color(1.5, 0.65, 0.75, tint.a), 0.7)
  74 			if health.dead:
  75 				tint.a *= health.hurt_left / 0.28
  76 		elif combat != null and combat.dodge_invulnerable:
  77 			tint = Color(0.75, 0.85, 1.3, 0.7)
  78 		visual.node.modulate = tint
